title: Faceted values
body:
Just wondering if I am able to do this through a widget or something that is already built (new to this!)

The top section is a repeat of the second section. I want them to both to show the faceted values but the top section I want to link through to a different URL - so not act as a facet, but still show faceted values? And the URL to be generated from the category name and the current faceted values.
